retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait layout featuring a central subject against a black void, anchored by large, glowing neon-style diagonal lettering in the upper left.
excludeWhen: flat 2D vector illustrations without lighting effects

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a smiling figure positioned in the lower right quadrant, set against a solid black background. The composition is dominated by large, stylized neon-tube lettering that descends diagonally from the top left, featuring multiple glowing outlines in cyan and yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal text flow opposing the subject's gaze
High contrast between the black background and vibrant neon outlines
Subject's head positioned as a visual counterweight to the large initial letter
Color harmony between the subject's blue attire and the cyan neon glow
coreInvariants: Solid black background with no environmental detail
Multi-layered neon glow effect on display text
Diagonal text orientation at approximately 30-45 degrees

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-close portrait occupying the bottom right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized, stylized initial letter in the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright neon text in the top left, follows the diagonal descent to the subject's face, and ends at the smaller signature-style text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the top right and center left to separate text from subject.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow/Pale Gold (Inner Neon Glow and Secondary Text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the neon elements against a zero-value background creates a luminous effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded, monolinear script and block hybrids
letterConstructionRules: Double or triple concentric outlines to simulate neon tubes
Interlocking or overlapping letterforms on the diagonal axis
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'E' features a zig-zag, lightning-bolt-like structure
Lowercase letters are connected in a fluid, tube-like script

composition.relationshipToImage: floats above background, separate from subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-energy neon display text paired with a delicate, formal script for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, glowing aesthetic of the display text.
Approximate vibe for the secondary script text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium-close portrait of a person with 80s-style hair and fashion, smiling, positioned in the lower right against a solid, pitch-black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, diagonal neon-style lettering in the top left using cyan and yellow concentric outlines with a soft outer glow. Add a small, elegant script name in the bottom right corner in pale yellow.

verificationChecks: Does the display text have a multi-layered neon glow?
Is the display text oriented on a downward diagonal?
Is the subject positioned in the lower right quadrant?

mustRedesign: Standard horizontal typesetting for the main title
postGenerationChecks: Check that neon outlines are concentric and glowing.
Ensure the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the background is pure black without noise.
Confirm the diagonal tilt of the main text is consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Black Background + Diagonal Neon Display Text + Secondary Script Metadata
